title: Our Services
seoTitle: Expert Metal Roofing Services in Toronto | Residential & Commercial
description: Explore professional metal roofing services that ensure durability and reliability for your property. Contact Rudan Roofing for expert installation and repairs

sections.text: The demand for metal roofing and siding is growing. We are here to help with our beautiful & functional products from Rudan Metal Roofing. Integrate a selection from our extensive variety of profiles and colors into your next project!
Protect Your Property with Rudan Roofing Services
A wide selection of customizable steel coil options available in a variety of sizes, grades, surface finishes, and forms.
Catered to fit your unique projects, customizable flashings and trims can be bent to your exact specifications to fit any of your project needs.
Rudan Roll Form division is a custom roll former based in Bowmanville Canada.

The Metal Sheet Flat Stock can be altered into almost any shape and used for virtually any project, Metal sheet is a flat rolled product that comes from a coil. Commonly used for building flashing, repairs and a wide array of other applications

Extensive Program with the highest of industry standards. We are Metal Experts that offer an extensive slit coil and flat sheet program. You can choose from a wide selection of colors and textures of finishes
